description: Live status of Matrix' background work — chunking, embedding and knowledge-graph extraction progress (active, done/total, errors, current phase) — plus the most recent application log lines (errors, warnings, MCP calls). Use it to follow long-running ingestion or graph jobs and to diagnose failures; for one specific job use job_status. This program adds shared_folders (what Matrix may read, with problems such as a folder that does not exist), search_model (state of the search model and the date of its recommendation), model_task_queue (tasks waiting for you) and running_jobs.

log_lines.description: How many recent log lines to include (0-200, default 20).

min_level.description: Lowest log level to include (default info).

name: get_status
